== Walkthrough ==

Talk to the Shaman Master, Zulort, and say "me Gonna Help!"

He'll give you a simple quest to get 4 Froglock Tadpole Fleshies. Requires Higher than Indifferent faction. 

'''Hand him 4 [[Froglok Tadpole Flesh]] (not stacked)'''

: Zulort says, 'Oh, me.. um.. Warlord BERRY happy.  Berry like dese.  Gimme.  Uh, why is you still here?  Take dis and gets more kills.  You learning good, come sees me. I teaches you bout stuff.  Make you [bedder shaman].  Go.  He and me watching.'

<div class='facblock'>
* Your faction standing with [[Shamen of War]] got better.
